description.value: Bold 'N' Cold Liquor is a locally operated liquor store in Nanaimo offering an extensive selection of craft beers, fine wines, and spirits across more than 175 SKUs. Multiple service options — in-store, curbside pickup, and same-day delivery — make it a flexible stop for cyclists restocking supplies. An on-site ATM and cigarette sales add further convenience for those travelling without a card.

address.value: 6201 Blueback Rd Unit 101, Nanaimo, BC V9V 1M8
